description: Land Title Settlement Department - Bagathure, Balangoda D/S Division, Rathnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620025 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, locations, and ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land registration and title settlement processes, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
